sections.label: Magenta Line: Janakpuri West to Krishna Park Extension
sections.basis: Every second Magenta train runs on to Krishna Park Extension (Wikipedia, as of Apr 2026). At opening it was a 16-minute shuttle (Metro Rail Today, 5 Jan 2025).
sources: DMRC Annual Report 2024-25 (published Nov 2025), Directors' Report §2.2-2.3: 1.810 km Janakpuri West to Krishna Park, inaugurated 05.01.2025
Metro Rail Today, 'DMRC opens first section of Delhi Metro Phase 4 from Janakpuri West - Krishna Park Extension', 5 Jan 2025
Wikipedia, Magenta Line (Delhi Metro), read 23 Nov 2026

sections.basis: Runs as its own service, not through to Botanical Garden (Wikipedia). No published headway was found, so trains are spaced like the feed's Magenta Line timetable.
sources: ThePrint (PTI), 'DMRC begins operations on two new metro corridors', 8 Mar 2026

sections.label: Pink Line: Majlis Park to Maujpur-Babarpur, closing the ring
sections.basis: Pink trains now run round the ring in both directions (Wikipedia). Trains reaching Majlis Park are assumed to carry on to Maujpur-Babarpur, and trains reaching Maujpur-Babarpur from Welcome are assumed to carry on round the ring via Yamuna Vihar. The feed's own Pink trains still also run to Shiv Vihar. Soorghat is built but not open, so trains pass it (Google Maps also counts 7 stops Majlis Park to Yamuna Vihar). Run times are scaled so Majlis Park to Yamuna Vihar takes 20 minutes, as Google Maps shows.
sources: Google Maps transit directions, screenshot shared by pranjal 23 Nov 2026: Majlis Park to Yamuna Vihar, 7 stops, 20 min (used to calibrate run times)
